input.quote: M&I hereby grants to Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license, through the end of the Term, to use the source code (including the right to make modifications thereto) on the terms and conditions set forth in this Article 23
input.rationale: The only licence granted to us is the Article 23 source code licence, which is expressly "non-transferable" and is reinforced by the Section 23.5 bar on transfer or assignment to any third party. That fails the fallback requirement of transferability to a successor in a merger or acquisition; the Section 22.4 assignment carve-out covers assignment of the Agreement only, and only where the surviving corporation joins a financial institution with $100,000,000 of capital and surplus, so it does not make the licence itself successor-transferable. Affiliate coverage is already satisfied because the defined "Customer" includes its Affiliates (and Section 21.10 confirms Affiliate processing), so we added no duplicate affiliate wording. We targeted the fallback with the shortest change: a successor-transfer permission in the grant plus a conforming carve-out to the 23.5 restriction so the two clauses do not contradict. We have not pressed the preferred position (contractor coverage, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence) given the term-limited escrow-release structure.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
mappings.quote: Tri City National Bank, a Wisconsin corporation (including its Affiliates, "Customer")

mappings.element: The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Make the Article 23 source code licence transferable to Customer's successor in a merger or acquisition.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the licence must transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so we made the Section 23.4 grant transferable to Customer's successor and carved that successor out of the Section 23.5 third-party transfer restriction. Affiliates already fall within the defined "Customer", so no further affiliate wording is needed.

ops.newText: M&I hereby grants to Customer a non-exclusive license, transferable to Customer's successor by merger or acquisition, through the end of the Term,

ops.oldText: but shall not (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party
ops.newText: but shall not (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party other than Customer's successor by merger or acquisition
